title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Re-Placement Retention on Loan-Event Credits
content:
**Re-placement retention for a loan event — Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs.** Tidemark keeps, without taking the loan-event credit below zero, 80 dollars of it when three or more certificates have been issued under the program on the credited certificate's loan number, 40 dollars when exactly two have, and nothing when only one has.

The count is of the program's issue entries carrying the credited certificate's loan number, the credited certificate's own issue entry included.

| Certificates issued under the program on that loan number | Kept |
|---|---|
| One (the credited certificate alone) | Nothing |
| Two | 40 dollars |
| Three or more | 80 dollars |

*Hypothetical:* a loan placed in three separate lapses, the latest certificate now ending on a payoff, counts three certificates; 80 dollars is kept from its loan-event credit.
